rationale: First-cut sizing: I_tail~90uA, I_2~120uA for SR>30V/us; mn1 sized for gm1~1mS (UGBW~100MHz with Cc=1.2pF); mp3 and Rc=4k sized for PM>60deg.
Reduce Cc from 1.2pF to 0.9pF to scale UGBW from 76MHz to ~101MHz (UGBW ~ gm1/(2*pi*Cc)), trading excess phase margin (75.8 deg -> ~65-70 deg).
raise mn1 12->18: increases input pair width by 50%, boosting gm1; expect ugbw 79.4MHz -> ~100MHz while maintaining phm > 65 deg.
reduce cap 0.9pF->0.7pF: lowers Miller capacitance Cc to boost UGBW; expect ugbw 80.95MHz -> ~103MHz with phm > 60 deg.
raise mn4 3->4: increases tail current from 90uA to 120uA to directly boost input pair gm1 and slew rate; expect ugbw 84.8MHz -> ~98-102MHz with SR > 60V/us.
